newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes firmer on dlr supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes firmer on dlr supply.

text.p: Increased dollar selling by both state-owned and foreign banks and high call rates helped the Bangladesh taka close firmer in interbank trading on Wednesday, dealers said.
The taka ended at 43.7500/7550 to the U.S. currency, against the previous close at 43.7500/7600.
The local currency opened at Tuesday's closing level but gained further after a foreign bank joined state-owned banks in selling the greenback.
The call money was traded at 13 percent to 15 percent, up from previous 12-15 percent, dealers said. - Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
